opennyai_summary.facts:
2. The applicant seeks bail in Crime No.274 of 2024  registered with Gandhi Chowk Police Station, District Latur for the  offence punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian  Penal Code and Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
The  applicant was apprehended with Gutka.
The muddemal has been recovered.
4. The learned APP submits that he is a habitual offender.
opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Except Section 328, other sections are bailable.
5. In the circumstances, instead of refusing bail, certain  stringent conditions may be imposed.
Bail Application is allowed.
(ii) Applicant, Sami Jakiyoddin Sayyad, be released on bail on furnishing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount in the above crime, on the conditions that;
(a) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses and shall attend the trial on each and every date.
(b) The applicant shall furnish an undertaking before the police that he would not involve in similar crime in future.
(c) If he is involved in similar crime, the prosecution may file an application for cancellation of bail.
